name: supplementary-media-accessibility-guard
description: Synthetic supplementary media accessibility preview guard for SCIBASE scientific data and code hosting.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check sample-data.js && node --check test.js && node --check demo.js && node --check make-demo-video.js
scripts.verify-video: ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=codec_name,width,height,duration,avg_frame_rate -show_entries format=duration,size -of default=noprint_wrappers=1 reports/demo.mp4
